strategy_roster.name: VWAP Behavioral Bias Filter
strategy_roster.notes: The docs give no explicit condition ('see implementation') and no numeric scale, so the BiasWindowSize 20 window is kept as an SMA with the BiasThreshold 0.5 mapped to a normalized 0.5-sigma bias and VWMA approximated by the same average. The custom Behavioral indicator, the 2m ATR-style stop and the 5-minute timeframe are not representable.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger Volatility Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Documented BollingerPeriod 20 and BollingerDeviation 2.0 give the band break, and the documented AtrPeriod 14 is used as a volatility-expansion gate standing in for AtrDeviationMultiplier 2.0. StopLossMultiplier 2.0 is an ATR distance from entry rather than a percent field, and the short leg and 5-minute timeframe are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Aeron Robot Grid
strategy_roster.notes: The only market-derived rule is the documented grid step (buy when price falls by Gap points from the last buy price), translated as a one-bar drop of about 1% because Gap, GapFactor, TakeProfit and StopLoss have no documented values. FirstLot, LotsFactor volume scaling, MaxTrades, Hedging and multi-order averaging cannot be represented by the single-position long engine.

strategy_roster.name: MAVA Xonax
strategy_roster.notes: The documented reversal rule is reproduced exactly with the documented EmaPeriod 6: EMA(open) crossing above EMA(close) enters long and the opposite cross exits. The stop and target are derived from high/low EMA ranges rather than percentages, and the 240-minute timeframe and short leg are not translated.

strategy_roster.name: Price Action Fractal
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low(low,5) and ema(close,9) > ema(close,21) and (roc(close,14) >= 2 or roc(close,14) <= -2) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: A fresh five-candle down fractal is expressed as the current low at the 5-bar range extreme, the fast/slow weighted averages are approximated by EMA 9/21 and MomentumPeriod 14 is the documented 14-bar ROC with a 2% MomentumThreshold fallback. MACD 12/26/9 is exact; StopLossPoints, TakeProfitPoints, trailing, break-even and FractalLifetime are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Berlin Range Index
strategy_roster.notes: The ATR-filtered Choppiness Index is not available, so a trending regime is approximated with ADX at the documented Length 9 and the ChopMin 10 / ChopMax 40 thresholds mapped to 25 / 20, and the long side takes the documented current-candle direction (close above open). The StdDevLength 14 normalisation and LowLookback 14 filters are not reproduced and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Opening Range Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The 09:30-10:15 opening range cannot be identified on daily bars, so a prior 5-bar range stands in as the range box with the documented MinRangePercent 0.35 read as 0.35%. RewardRisk 1.1, the 0.5 retrace exit, the one-trade-per-day rule, losing-trade reversal and the 15:45 end-of-day flat are all session or sizing logic outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: RoBoost
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 'previous close lower or equal to the current close' is exactly close >= sma(close,2), and the RSI-above-RsiUp long rule becomes a cross above the midline. RsiPeriod, RsiUp and RsiDown are documented only as names with no values, so RSI(14) and 50 are fallbacks; TakeProfit, StopLoss and the trailing tools are absolute price distances, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Roulette Game
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state there is no technical filter and the direction is a random coin flip per candle, so no deterministic long signal exists and the never-true close<0 guard is used. Martingale staking, virtual bankroll, MaxMultiplier, losing-streak reset and round cooldowns are position-management logic outside the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Stoch Sell
strategy_roster.notes: The strategy only ever sends an initial market sell and then a ladder of pending sell stops, and every oscillator setting (three stochastic triplets, OversoldLevel, LongTermOversoldLevel, ATR threshold) is documented by name only with no values, so a mirrored long entry would be entirely fabricated. The never-true close<0 guard records that instead; grid orders and pip targets are unsupported.
